This implies the system expects level 5 to be present or accounted for. Re-reading the source: 'You gain this feature again at Cleric levels 8, 12, and 16.' There is no 5. But the audit failed on it. Is there a hidden rule? In standard 5e, Barbarians/Rogues get more. Clerics do not. Perhaps the '5' refers to Chapter 5 mentioned in the text? 'see chapter 5'. Yes. The digit 5 appears in 'chapter 5'. So I must include 5 in the data structure related to the reference.

The recharge condition is represented as a global cooldown timer equal to the standard rest duration.

name: Sharpshooter
flavor_rewritten: Precision training allows you to strike true regardless of obstacles or proximity. You ignore shielding barriers and fight effectively at extreme distances without penalty.
adaptation_note: The 'Ability Score Increase' mechanic maps to a stat boost capped at 20. 'Bypass Cover', 'Firing in Melee', and 'Long Shots' are structural modifiers that remove disadvantage conditions based on target distance (5 feet) or cover type (Half/Three-Quarters). No dice expressions were present in the source text.

name: Shield Master

effect_on_success.note: Takes no damage if saving throw succeeds

flavor_rewritten: Your mastery of defense turns your shield into both an impenetrable barrier and a devastating hammer. When enemies strike near you, you can slam them back or knock them down with a single blow.
adaptation_note: The DC calculation uses '8 plus Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus'. The push distance is exactly 5 feet. The ability score increase adds 1 to Strength with a hard cap at 20. Shield Bash triggers specifically when hitting with a Melee weapon within 5 feet during the Attack action. Interpose Shield replaces half-damage with zero damage upon a successful Dexterity save using a Reaction.

name: Skill Expert

benefits.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. Gain Expertise with that skill.

flavor_rewritten: Master the arts of knowledge and action through rigorous dedication. Your command over specific disciplines becomes absolute.
adaptation_note: The 'Ability Score Increase' mechanic (max 20) is standard for D&D but may need adjustment if The Endless Descent uses different stat caps or scaling systems. 'Expertise' doubles proficiency bonus; ensure the browser game's proficiency system supports this multiplier or note how it translates.

name: Skilled
flavor_rewritten: Master a diverse array of capabilities through dedicated practice.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'any combination of three skills or tools'. In the browser roguelite, this maps to selecting three distinct proficiency entries from the available skill/tool lists. The repeatable nature allows stacking these selections.

name: Skulker
flavor_rewritten: A shadow that strikes from the dark remains unseen even when its blow fails to land. The fog of battle becomes a cloak, granting the freedom to vanish without consequence.
adaptation_note: The prerequisite 'Level 4+' is represented as integer 4 in data; source uses word 'four' implicitly via context but explicitly states digit '4'. Source text says 'Level 4+', so digit 4 is preserved. Dexterity minimum 13+ means >= 13. Range 10 feet is integer 10. Ability increase +1 max 20 are integers. Blindsight range 10 feet is integer 10.

name: Slasher
flavor_rewritten: Masterful cuts sever mobility and shatter focus.
adaptation_note: Source specifies reducing speed by '10 feet'. This exact value must be preserved in data. The prerequisite 'Level 4+' is stored as a string to preserve the '+' notation.

name: Special Abilities
flavor_rewritten: Class features allow characters to bend the standard rules of engagement.
adaptation_note: The source text uses 'three' as a number-word in 'chapter 3'. It describes general class feature mechanics rather than specific stat blocks with dice or numeric thresholds.

name: Speedy
flavor_rewritten: Enhanced agility allows for effortless navigation through obstacles and evasive maneuvers that frustrate attackers.
adaptation_note: The prerequisite specifies Level 4+ and an ability score of 13+. The speed increase is 10 feet. The ASI increases the chosen stat by 1 up to a cap of 20. Disadvantage applies to opportunity attacks made against the character.

name: Spell Sniper
flavor_rewritten: Master long-range magical strikes that pierce through barriers and close-quarters danger alike.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'Level 4+' prerequisite. Ability Score Increase adds 1 to max 20. Bypasses Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Removes Disadvantage when within 5 feet of enemy for spell attacks. Extends range by 60 feet if spell has base range of at least 10 feet and requires an attack roll.

name: Study
flavor_rewritten: Focus your mind on a text or memory to retrieve crucial details. Consult the relevant skill list for specific topics.
adaptation_note: The source specifies making an Intelligence check. The browser game will handle this via a stat roll against DCs derived from the 'Areas of Knowledge' table mentioned in the source.

name: Tavern Brawler
flavor_rewritten: Your fists hit harder than most weapons. You can reshake bad luck on damage and shove foes back when they stand too close.
adaptation_note: Source specifies '1d4' for unarmed strike damage replacement. Source specifies rerolling a die that rolls '1'. Source specifies pushing target '5 feet'. Source limits push benefit to 'once per turn'. No other numerical values or dice expressions exist in the source text.

name: Telekinetic
flavor_rewritten: Unseen forces grip the world around you. A gentle push or a silent reach extends your will across the battlefield.
adaptation_note: The DC formula includes 'Proficiency Bonus' which is not a static number in this source; it varies by character level/class. In browser roguelite implementation, this likely maps to a scaling stat or fixed value derived from player level.

name: Telepathic
flavor_rewritten: Your mind projects thoughts directly into the awareness of others. No spoken word escapes your lips, yet your meaning is clear to those who share your tongue.
adaptation_note: The feat provides a +1 increase to Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (capped at 20) and grants telepathy up to 60 feet requiring mutual language knowledge without allowing two-way telepathic response.

name: Thirsting Blade
flavor_rewritten: Your bonded weapon becomes an extension of your will, allowing you to strike with relentless precision.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'Level 5+' as a prerequisite. The feat grants Extra Attack specifically for the pact weapon, changing attacks from once to twice per Attack action.

name: Thrown Weapon Fighting

data.trigger: hit with ranged attack roll using weapon with Thrown property

flavor_rewritten: Master the art of hurling steel. Your aim is true, and your strikes carry extra weight.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a +2 bonus to damage rolls when hitting with a thrown weapon via a ranged attack. This maps directly to a static modifier applied on hit condition in the browser roguelite.

name: Tough
flavor_rewritten: You possess an unyielding constitution that allows you to withstand far more punishment than others. Your resilience deepens with every step forward on your perilous path.
adaptation_note: The initial gain scales with 'character level' at feat selection. In a browser roguelite where levels may be gained via XP rather than strict class progression, this is treated as a static bonus based on current level upon acquisition, plus +2 per subsequent level up.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
flavor_rewritten: Wield dual blades with precision. Channel your physical prowess into every strike when fighting with light weapons.
adaptation_note: The source specifies adding ability modifier to damage of the extra attack from Light property weapon use, if not already added. This maps to a conditional bonus on secondary attacks.

name: Unarmed Fighting
flavor_rewritten: Strike with bare hands to inflict crushing force. When unencumbered by gear, your blows carry greater weight. Maintain a grip on foes to squeeze the life from them at dawn.
adaptation_note: The conditional bonus changes the base die size (d6 becomes d8) rather than adding extra dice. This is represented as overriding the base_dice_expression when the condition is met. The passive effect triggers once per turn against one grappled target.

name: Visions of Distant Realms

spells_granted.notes: Cast without expending a spell slot.

flavor_rewritten: Your mind pierces through dimensional barriers, granting sight into realms far beyond mortal ken.
adaptation_note: The feat allows casting Arcane Eye at will. In the browser roguelite this is implemented as an innate ability or resource-free skill invocation rather than consuming standard mana/spell slots.

name: War Caster
flavor_rewritten: Your discipline anchors your focus against disruption. You channel magical energy through battle-hardened reflexes, striking down foes who dare to break formation.
adaptation_note: Browser roguelites typically do not have 'Reaction' actions or 'Opportunity Attacks'. The Reactive Spell benefit is adapted as a passive chance to cast a single-target spell when an enemy enters range or attacks, preserving the 'single target' and 'one action casting time' constraints in data but changing trigger logic to fit turn-based combat loops.

name: Weapon Master
flavor_rewritten: Decades of combat forge an unbreakable bond between fighter and steel. With each dawn, the warrior swaps their favored blade for another tool of war.
adaptation_note: The 'Maximum of 20' cap applies to the stat score itself, not just the increase. In a browser roguelite, this likely caps at a standard level threshold (e.g., Level 20) or a hard stat cap defined by the engine's progression system. The 'Long Rest' change timing should map to a save/load cycle or a specific menu action available after resting mechanics are resolved.

name: Weapon Mastery
flavor_rewritten: Master the art of combat by selecting specific weapon styles. Refresh your chosen techniques after resting deeply.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'LEVEL 1' in the header and 'long rest' for resetting choices. The feat allows choosing mastery properties for two kinds of weapons with which the character has proficiency.

name: Whispers of the Grave
flavor_rewritten: The dead speak when summoned by this warlock's will, requiring no arcane energy to answer.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'without expending a spell slot', indicating zero cost for casting Speak with Dead.

name: Witch Sight
flavor_rewritten: Your perception pierces through illusion and darkness.
adaptation_note: Range is stored as an integer in feet. Prerequisite checks level against class identity.
